subject: 10-motor-speed-circuit.pico.svg
verdict: Inherited golden mismatch; no change introduced by the Microtronic supplier adoption.
scope: One targeted rendering comparison. No baseline, gate, source, dependency, or pin edits; no broad suite.

host.explanation: The production renderer script injects AuditBoard rather than importing the bw-board runtime.

suppliers.sidecars: All src/parts-data/*.json files from each supplier's own immutable Git tree were registered.

mechanism.description: The installed package was rendered normally. Each immutable Git UI was executed using SourceTextModule with relative-import linking to git-show source, sharing its own module cache. Both used the exact AuditBoard setup, all of their own JSON sidecars, Circuit.fromJSON, and renderSchematicSvg({parts, nets: resolvedNets}, {dark:false}). The current Git result matched the installed-package result.

goldenDifference.description: A single three-segment wire detour moved from y=201 to y=193; endpoints and every other byte remain identical.
